scope: Selected +15X upper B-fill guide and scoped2.4mm cover. Lower reservoir bore/stem tip, V-A tube, PCB and other installed rigid poses remain fixed. Only the two fittings, direct internal link, changed fluid24 tail and added cup/lid stock are checked against local saved native neighbors. This is CAD layout/capture evidence, not physical load, pressure, tolerance, foam sealing or installation qualification.

stock_input.basis: Saved source-built world stock from the preceding same-geometry run

exposed_link.receiving_depth_scope: Observed socket faces define exposed tube only. The JG receiving depth is unmeasured; use actual receiving marks for the physical cut.

qualification_limits: The upper2.4mm cover is a dry fitting restraint beneath the PCB, not an enclosure ceiling or a fluid-pressure wall.
Upward capture transfers through the broad cover into the pocket walls/lid; no pull-force or lifetime capacity is established.
The original2mm cup floor remains around the lower reservoir stem. Mask the dry fitting pockets/link during the clamped foam pour; dry mating faces are not foam or vapor seals.
The lid retains its flat underside-down print frame and saved Tree(auto)/Default support decisions. Geometric access does not qualify support removal or physical print thickness.
Saved native lead bodies and approach witnesses retain their explicitly named source scope. No whole-appliance replay or flexible handling claim is inferred.
result_scope: Physical source-native layout is clear; the four separately named approach/handling witnesses are not an access pass. Canonical cap/core artifact binding remains pending the selected export.

J10_entry_diagnostic.scope: An OD3mm by8mm straight+Y layout witness, not manufacturer-qualified handling or insertion clearance. The upper B-fill fitting is captured before PCB installation; the separately staged V-B return is not a solution to this diagnostic.
J10_entry_diagnostic.physical_entry_and_service: Unqualified; no new handling procedure is inferred from the installed-wire noncontact reading.

metadata_only_classification.scope: Classifies the saved native rows into physical contacts and approach witnesses; no geometry or native reading changes.

service_comparison.scope: Only the three saved vertical withdrawal witnesses versus the same old/new fluid24 tail region, plus the J10 entry witness and two actual screw tools. Connector handling, flexible tube displacement and force are not qualified.
service_comparison.assembly_order: Terminate both J10 power leads on the loose PCB, then fasten the PCB to the core and land the free ends at the core WAGOs. The captured B-fill upper fitting is already inside the closed cap. This does not qualify installed wire insertion/withdrawal service; field retermination may require unbolting/staging the PCB and flexible leads.
service_comparison.connector_service: Disconnect and stage the flexible B-fill tube for the recorded vertical J5/J6/J13 service approaches. No handling path or force is established by the witness intersection alone.
